stage_title: A Ground - what exists and what the model has to hold
item: Coverage: every 00-CAR part against what exists for it - a found model in 01-REFERENCE cad (exact or close), a piece of the combined model (blend), a factory dimension (specs), a catalogue figure - as a query, with the count of parts that have nothing
note: A derivation, not a typed table (R2). 975 parts, 900 cad rows, 7 blend pieces on 2026-10-11. · DONE 2026-10-12: model/coverage.py derives it from 00-CAR parts and specs and 01-REFERENCE cad and blend each time (--list TIER, --system S). Read today: 39 parts have a model file, 18 are placed in the combined model, 152 have a factory dimension in mm or in, 200 have a found model whose name matches (a hint - nobody has opened the file against the part), 962 have a catalogue figure (shape, not size), 11 have nothing (fuel 4, engine 2, electrical 2, body 2, climate 1). stage_title: A Ground - what exists and what the model has to hold
item: The frame and the hard points: the model's one coordinate frame (D-418's: mm, x right, y forward, z up, ground z 0, front axle y 0) and every factory dimension that fixes a point in it (SP-131 to SP-135, SP-234 to SP-240, the manuals' body dimension pages), gathered as the datums every part is checked against
note: Factory figures only; nothing here is measured on the car, so each datum says its source and page. · DONE 2026-10-12: the datums table - the frame (D-418), the wheel centres from wheelbase and tracks, the overall length, width, height and ground clearance, the ride-height reference and the underbody body-checking holes (SP-234 to SP-240). Eleven coordinates the record cannot fix carry confirm: the overhang split, the underbody datum line's height, the lengthwise positions of the frame holes. The body checking pages (S-002 p.14-24) are the first place to read them; the car is the second (block 05.03).

stage_title: A Ground - what exists and what the model has to hold
item: The model's own tables: one row per modelled part keyed to 00-CAR parts - its file, what it was made from, how each governing dimension is known (measured, factory figure, found model, guess), its mates and fasteners, its confirm state - declared in _schema so accuracy is a column, not a claim (R11)
note: DONE 2026-10-12: three tables declared in _schema and _tables, empty until B01 - model_parts keyed by the 00-CAR parts id with made_from and state as enums and a confirm column; model_dims with how each figure is known and the date it was measured; model_mates with kind, fasteners and offset. Every row A05 plans and B01 / B02 fill is checked by the same tool as the rest of the record.

stage_title: A Ground - what exists and what the model has to hold
item: The parts plan: every part to model, grouped by system and zone, in build order (what comes off the car first is measured first), with what each needs from Camden
note: D-517, D-518. Gaps the plan found in 00-CAR: fasteners are almost absent (only wheel nuts, lock bolts, link bolts) though D-517 wants them and model_mates.fasteners refers to parts; no row for the hatch panel or its glass (PT037 the defrost grid stands in); no B-pillar panel row. stage_title: B Build - the model, system by system
item: First pass of the whole car from what exists: the shell, glass, wheels and powertrain from the found models placed on the hard points, every part its own solid, every unmeasured size marked confirm
note: D-518 (2026-10-13): the unibody core is built - 46 panel solids on the 29 panel rows (PT976 the centre pillars added to 00-CAR), 18 hard-point nodes, the envelope on DT04-DT07 (x ±834.4, roof 1260.0, lowest 149.6, length ends 4320.5), wheel centres on DT02/DT03; from S-002 p.14-24, the-blueprints 83684 and the 3D Warehouse FB shell scaled to the wheelbase, lifted 59.5 to the roof datum. D-563 (2026-10-13): the second pass - the skin assembly cut from the home page's FB model (PT704-skin, PT729 glass, PT704-trim, PT601-L/R, the FR/RL/RR wheels and tyres) and the unibody's outline re-read off its stations; 270 model_dims and 59 model_mates rows, every one confirm. Left for this row: the closures (hood, fenders, doors, hatch, bumpers) as parts of their own, the A-pillars about 30 mm proud of the skin (skin/fit_check.py), and the powertrain from the found models on the hard points (the SA model is on the Mac since B03). Biggest guesses: the underbody datum 60 above the ground, hole A 580 forward of the front axle; PT772, PT777 and PT761's readings need checking against the S-005 body figures. 2026-10-15: a plan run started from the app could not take it - the app's harness runs rx7.py and nothing else, so model/build.py, skin/fit_check.py and the render check are refused; what is left is geometry that must be built and looked at, so it needs a desk session on the Mac (FreeCAD, node).

stage_title: B Build - the model, system by system
item: Capture the parts the plan lists, by the method ruled in block 05.03, as each comes off the car
note: D-525: by hand - calipers, tape, photos against a ruler, as each part comes off. Becomes one row per system from the A05 plan (plan playbook). Unmeasured sizes stay confirm.

stage_title: C Manual - the model in the app
item: The hand-over to the app: what the Manual receives - the model split by system, each part addressable by its 00-CAR id, a camera and a taken-apart position for each procedure step - written as the contract 02-APP row MG1 builds its views on
note: D-518. A camera and a taken-apart position per procedure step come with the procedures when they are written (the Manual's procedures table), not here.
result: The hand-over is the car's scene.json under the app's public design folder keyed 00-CAR (the Design page's contract, version 2, with car: true, systems, and per part its 00-CAR id, kind body|part|node, system, zone, made_from, state and its mate with an apart vector so the app takes the car apart along the mates); written in 02-cad/model/README.md as C01's contract; MG1 is built on it.
